idea-plugin.name: GuydAI Theme
idea-plugin.description: Cyber dark theme for the GuydAI project. Pure-black IDE chrome with electric-blue and hot-pink neon accents, wrapped around the navy + gold "GuydAI" editor color scheme.
idea-plugin.change-notes: 1.1.0 — "Cyber Ice" redesign: pure-black (#04050a) chrome, electric-blue (#38bdf8) lead accents, hot-pink (#ff2e97) pops. Editor color scheme unchanged. 1.0.0 — Initial release. Navy chrome with gold accents.
